faq.q: Will it fit me?
faq.a: It's one size with an adjustable strap and metal buckle, which fits most adult heads.

faq.q: Will it be restocked?
faq.a: It's an exclusive run, so once it sells out it may not come back.

faq.q: When will my order arrive?
faq.a: Each piece is printed to order. Printing takes 2–4 business days, then shipping takes 3–7 business days within the USA, so about 5–11 business days in total. You'll get a tracking link by email when it ships.

faq.q: Do you ship outside the USA?
faq.a: Not yet. We ship to all 50 US states, including Hawaii and Alaska. We're working on New Zealand and Australia.

faq.q: What payment methods do you take?
faq.a: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Shop Pay at secure checkout.

faq.q: What's your return and exchange policy?
faq.a: Wrong size? Exchange unworn, unwashed items within 30 days of delivery. Misprinted, damaged or wrong items are replaced free: email a photo within 30 days. Every piece is printed to order, so returns for change of mind are store credit, and the customer pays return postage.

faq.q: How do I wash it?
faq.a: Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colours. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Do not iron directly on the print. Do not dry clean.
